_readme: What the competition is allowed to look at.
kalshi.classification_rules is the only place where a Kalshi series becomes a commodity in
this project. Rules are tested in order against '<series ticker> <series title>'. A series
that matches no rule is recorded as Unclassified and is NEVER traded: the platform does not
guess what an unlabelled market is about.
The first rule deliberately excludes cross-commodity ratio markets (e.g. gold vs silver),
which are not a price for a single commodity and therefore must not be traded as one.

kalshi.perp_asset_classes_note: Crypto added 2026-09-22 for the cross-venue crypto basis (Kalshi crypto perps vs MOEX BTC/ETH futures); both venues publish keyless official data.

classification_rules.note: Cross-commodity ratio market: it is not a price for a single commodity and is excluded from trading.

moex.max_contracts_note: Raised from 44 to 56 on 2026-09-22 to fund the non-commodity sectors (equity index, interest rate, FX, crypto) required by the project brief; sector contracts are capped separately at max_sector_contracts.
moex.asset_codes_note: Asset codes verified against the exchange's own FORTS listing on 2026-09-22. Codes that do not exist in the listing (PALL, BRENT, NGAS, DAMILK, CORN, SOY, RICE, LEAD) are kept as documented requests: the classifier only ever trades a code the exchange itself publishes, so a missing code simply trades nothing rather than guessing a substitute. The non-commodity sector codes (MIX, RTS, NASD, SPYF, RUONIA, 1MFR, Si, CNY, BTC, ETHA) were verified in the listing on 2026-09-22 and are traded from 2026-09-22 onward; ether is covered via the ETHA Trust ETF futures (ASSETCODE ETHA) because the MOEX-Ether-Index futures were not found in the listing.

fred.note: FRED CSV downloads are keyless. Where a series is the EIA spot series re-published by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, both publishers are named on the record.
